cta_note: CTA-to-CTA transfers between two different stations (a walk or a pedway, free with the same farecard), each named on a CTA station page (checked 2026-10-25). Stations that serve several lines under one CTA station id (Clark/Lake, Howard, ...) are interchanges by CTA's own data and need no entry here. Left out: Lake (Red) to State/Lake, which Lake's page names, because State/Lake isn't in CTA's current timetable (not on the map); and any pair no CTA page names (e.g. Monroe Red/Blue, Washington/Wabash).
